offering_description.value: Omnicom plans and buys media, creates advertising, and runs marketing campaigns for companies, nonprofits, and government agencies. Its agency networks also provide public relations, healthcare communications, customer marketing, commerce, and experiential marketing. It uses audience data and analytics to target campaigns and measure results.

primary_products.value: licensed audience datasets; customer identity data products; e-commerce analytics software

primary_services.value: media planning and buying; creative advertising and content production; public relations and healthcare communications; customer marketing and analytics; commerce and experiential marketing

customer_segment.value: B2B: Consumer brands, retailers, healthcare and technology companies, financial institutions, and nonprofits; B2G: Government agencies commissioning public information and recruitment campaigns

end_markets.value: consumer goods and retail; healthcare and pharmaceuticals; technology and telecommunications; financial services; automotive

revenue_model.value: service fees: Agency retainers for media, creative, communications, and marketing services; project or contract: Campaign development, content production, events, and other defined client assignments; commissions or management fees: Media placement and management of client advertising budgets; licensing or royalties: Access to audience datasets and customer identity data
revenue_model.category: service fees; project or contract; commissions or management fees; licensing or royalties

value_chain_position.value: service provider: Turns client briefs, audience research, and media inventory into campaigns for businesses and public agencies; software / platform: Combines audience, campaign, and retail data in planning and analytics tools for advertisers and retailers

geography_served.value: global: North America, Europe, Asia-Pacific, Latin America, the Middle East, and Africa

specialization.value: related lines: Media, creative advertising, branding, public relations, healthcare communications, customer marketing, commerce, production, and experiential marketing

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Agency account teams and pitches for client contracts; partners / resellers: Advertising technology and data platform partners that distribute audience data products

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: Audience targeting and data handling under GDPR and state privacy laws, and advertising claims under FTC rules

notes: The relative size of smaller service lines following the Interpublic acquisition is uncertain.
